beats.label: S1 · Blood on the border
beats.text: John Dutton's cattle stray onto reservation land and the confrontation kills his eldest son Lee. Estranged daughter Beth returns from Utah as the family closes ranks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the ranch-vs-reservation war, opens the succession hole Lee's death leaves, and puts Beth back on the board where she stays.

beats.label: S1 · Covering the bodies
beats.text: To shield third son Kayce from a murder charge, John has Lee's body cremated and orders his enforcer Rip to kill the medical examiner who signed the autopsy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows how far John will go and locks Kayce to the family through a shared crime; the reader needs this to read Kayce's later choices.

beats.label: S1 · The patriarch is dying
beats.text: John's colon-cancer surgery is quietly revealed, and tribal chief Thomas Rainwater warns him openly that the day he dies, the reservation will take the ranch back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a clock on the whole show and names the man who inherits the war whenever that clock runs out.

beats.label: S1 · Enemies join hands
beats.text: Developer Dan Jenkins and Chief Rainwater partner against the Duttons, running a coordinated legal and financial squeeze designed to bleed John off his land.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The alliance is the engine of the season's plot against John; the reader needs to know these two are working together.

beats.label: S1 · Kayce comes home alone
beats.text: After Monica is hospitalised with a brain injury and separates from him, Kayce moves into the ranch bunkhouse, pulling the son John needs most back inside the fence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The domestic split delivers Kayce to John, which is the family reshuffle the next season inherits.

beats.label: S1 · Jamie turns
beats.text: Cut off financially and pushed to abandon his attorney-general run, Jamie sits for a newspaper interview about his father, crossing a line the family will not forgive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the quiet betrayal that reframes Jamie for everything after; nothing else in season 1 sets up more.

beats.label: S1 · The rope at the tree
beats.text: Rip, Kayce and Jimmy hang Dan Jenkins by the neck until he names every conspirator, exposing the full plot against the ranch.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with John finally knowing who all his enemies are, and Jenkins alive and owned by the Duttons rather than dead.

cliffhanger.text: Jenkins has been strung up until he coughed the names of every player moving against the Yellowstone, and Jamie has just handed a reporter the story of his own father without anyone in the family knowing yet. John has Kayce and Rip back inside the fence, but he is dying, and the men trying to take the ranch now know who each other are.
questions: What will John do now that Jenkins has named every conspirator against him?
How does the family react when Jamie's interview about his father reaches print?
How long can John hide his cancer from the enemies now openly waiting for him to die?

characters.name: John Dutton
characters.line: Patriarch of the Yellowstone, secretly fighting colon cancer while at war with a developer, a reservation, and, increasingly, one of his own sons.

characters.name: Beth Dutton
characters.line: John's daughter, back from a finance career in Utah and running the family's counter-attack to dismantle Jenkins from the inside.

characters.name: Kayce Dutton
characters.line: John's third son and an ex-serviceman, separated from Monica after her injury and now living in the ranch bunkhouse.

characters.name: Jamie Dutton
characters.line: John's middle son and the family's lawyer, cut off by his father over his political ambitions and has just given a reporter an interview about him.

characters.name: Rip Wheeler
characters.line: John's enforcer and Beth's on-off partner; the man who does the killings, buries the bodies, and answers only to John.

characters.name: Monica Long Dutton
characters.line: Kayce's wife, a reservation schoolteacher recovering from brain surgery who has moved out on her own with their son Tate.

characters.name: Thomas Rainwater
characters.line: New chief of the Broken Rock reservation, openly promising to take the Yellowstone back the day John dies and now partnered with Jenkins.

characters.name: Dan Jenkins
characters.line: Real-estate developer squeezing the ranch financially, currently alive but broken after Rip hung him from a tree to name every co-conspirator.

beats.label: S2 · John Steps Back
beats.text: A ruptured ulcer nearly kills John and forces him to slow down. He starts grooming Kayce to run the ranch, sidelining Rip and unsettling the family hierarchy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the succession question that drives every family beat this season.

beats.label: S2 · Beth Backs Jamie's Rival
beats.text: Furious at Jamie, Beth recruits Cassidy Reid to run against him for Attorney General. Jamie's political path — and his standing in the family — starts collapsing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Jamie's isolation, which triggers the murder that defines his arc going forward.

beats.label: S2 · Jamie Kills The Reporter
beats.text: Jamie vents family secrets to journalist Sarah Nguyen. When she refuses to kill the story, he murders her on a riverbank to bury it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The secret Jamie now carries becomes leverage over him for seasons to come.

beats.label: S2 · The Becks Declare War
beats.text: Casino rivals Malcolm and Teal Beck are exposed as the enemy behind the cattle attacks and a deputy's death. John allies with Rainwater and Jenkins to fight them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's true villains and the unlikely coalition formed against them.

beats.label: S2 · Tate Is Taken
beats.text: The Becks retaliate by kidnapping Kayce's son Tate from the ranch. The whole family mobilises for a rescue that turns into open warfare.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The kidnapping is the emotional pivot that reshapes Kayce and Monica going into next season.

beats.label: S2 · The Becks Fall
beats.text: John and Kayce hunt the Becks down and get Tate back, ending the war in blood. Rip, meanwhile, receives an inheritance from a dying figure from his past.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the season's central threat and quietly repositions Rip's standing with the family.

cliffhanger.text: The Becks are dead and Tate is home, but the family is shaken — Kayce and Monica are raw from the kidnapping, Jamie is a murderer nobody knows about, and John's health has forced a real succession question into the open.
questions: How will Tate and Monica live with what happened to them?
How long can Jamie hide killing Sarah Nguyen, and who finds out first?
Who really runs the Yellowstone now that John has stepped back?

characters.name: John Dutton
characters.line: The patriarch, recovering from near-fatal surgery and finally admitting he cannot run the ranch alone forever.

characters.name: Kayce Dutton
characters.line: John's youngest son, now a livestock officer and heir apparent, tested in his first real leadership role.
characters.note: Married to Monica; father to Tate.

characters.name: Beth Dutton
characters.line: John's daughter and financial attack dog, waging open war on Jamie and on developer Dan Jenkins.

characters.name: Jamie Dutton
characters.line: The lawyer son, cut out of the family after leaking to a reporter and now secretly a murderer.
characters.note: Killed journalist Sarah Nguyen to bury the story.

characters.name: Rip Wheeler
characters.line: John's fiercely loyal ranch foreman, pushed aside by Kayce's rise but still the family's enforcer.

characters.name: Monica Dutton
characters.line: Kayce's wife, a new college instructor rebuilding her life apart from the ranch, and shattered by Tate's kidnapping.

characters.name: Tate Dutton
characters.line: Kayce and Monica's young son, kidnapped by the Becks and rescued only after violence he witnessed firsthand.

characters.name: Thomas Rainwater
characters.line: Chief of the neighboring reservation; a rival turned reluctant ally against the Becks.

characters.name: Dan Jenkins
characters.line: The developer Beth has been tormenting; forced into the anti-Beck alliance after their attacks hit him too.

characters.name: Jimmy Hurdstrom
characters.line: A young ranch hand paying off his past debts and chasing rodeo money to keep his grandfather safe.

beats.label: S3 · Succession Shuffle
beats.text: John steps down as Livestock Commissioner and installs Jamie, then swaps him into interim Attorney General so Kayce can take the badge instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets every Dutton's job title going into S4 — Jamie in state law, Kayce as commissioner, John free to fight the developers directly.

beats.label: S3 · The Airport Play
beats.text: Market Equities, fronted by Roarke Morris and CEO Willa Hays, moves to seize 50,000 Dutton acres for a resort and airport, pressuring the Governor toward eminent domain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonist and the specific threat driving every Dutton decision from here on.

beats.label: S3 · The Abortion Clinic
beats.text: A flashback reveals teenage Jamie took a pregnant Beth to a reservation clinic that sterilised her without warning. Beth finally tells John, and the family rift becomes permanent.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Beth's hatred of Jamie and why she cannot have children with Rip — the emotional engine of everything she does next.

beats.label: S3 · Jamie's Real Father
beats.text: Jamie discovers John is not his biological father and confronts the man who is, a revelation that begins pulling him away from the family that raised him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single most important character shift of the season — Jamie's loyalty is now genuinely in play.

beats.label: S3 · Rip and Beth
beats.text: Beth asks Rip to marry her, cementing him as her chosen family as she is fired by Willa Hays and turns her full firepower on Market Equities.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the Rip/Beth partnership and Beth's personal war footing heading into the finale attacks.

beats.label: S3 · Broken Rock Awakens
beats.text: A murdered girl on the reservation radicalises Monica, and Angela Blue Thunder tells Chief Rainwater the land must be taken back by force, not negotiated for.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Rainwater on a more militant path and reframes the reservation as its own power moving against Market Equities.

beats.label: S3 · Coordinated Hit
beats.text: Cornered at the negotiating table, John refuses to sell. Within hours the Duttons are hunted one by one in coordinated assassination attempts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the literal cliffhanger — the state of the family as S4 opens.

cliffhanger.text: After John rejects Market Equities' final offer, the Duttons are attacked simultaneously in an orchestrated hit — leaving John, Beth and Kayce all fighting for their lives at once.
questions: Who ordered the attacks — Market Equities, the reservation, or someone closer to home?
Now that Jamie knows John isn't his real father, whose side will he take when the family bleeds?

characters.name: John Dutton
characters.line: Patriarch who has handed off the Livestock Commissioner badge to fight Market Equities directly, and has just refused to sell an acre.

characters.name: Beth Dutton
characters.line: Fired by Willa Hays and out for revenge, newly engaged to Rip, and finally free of the secret about what Jamie did to her.

characters.name: Jamie Dutton
characters.line: Interim Attorney General who has just learned John is not his biological father and met the man who is.
characters.note: His loyalty to the family is, for the first time, genuinely uncertain.

characters.name: Kayce Dutton
characters.line: The new Livestock Commissioner, still living rough at the summer camp with Monica and Tate.

characters.name: Rip Wheeler
characters.line: Ranch foreman and Beth's fiancé, having just killed the Duttons' rival Wade Morrow and branded a reluctant Walker back into the fold.

characters.name: Monica Dutton
characters.line: Kayce's wife, radicalised by the murder of a girl on Broken Rock and newly committed to justice for Native women.

characters.name: Thomas Rainwater
characters.line: Chief of the Broken Rock reservation, allied with John against Market Equities but being pushed by Angela Blue Thunder to take the land back by force.

characters.name: Willa Hays
characters.line: CEO of Market Equities, the developer running the airport-and-resort play against the ranch.

characters.name: Roarke Morris
characters.line: Willa's hedge-fund fixer on the ground in the valley, and Beth's personal target all season.

characters.name: Jimmy Hurdstrom
characters.line: Ranch hand chasing a rodeo career with girlfriend Mia, recovering from a serious accident.

beats.label: S4 · Family Survives Hits
beats.text: The Duttons survive the coordinated attacks: John is shot but stabilised, Beth walks out of her bombed office, and Kayce guns down his ambushers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes that the season opens with the family alive but hunting whoever ordered the hit — the engine of everything that follows.

beats.label: S4 · Trail to Riggins
beats.text: John and Kayce hunt the hit squads and trace the plot to an imprisoned felon named Riggins. John hands the file to Jamie as a loyalty test.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the mechanism by which the family will eventually prove Jamie's complicity.

beats.label: S4 · Jamie's Father
beats.text: Jamie learns Riggins shared a cell with his biological father, Garrett Randall. Garrett hands him a son by ex-girlfriend Christina and pulls him deeper into a new family.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Garrett-Jamie bond is the whole reason Jamie ends the season compromised.

beats.label: S4 · John Runs
beats.text: Governor Perry publicly endorses John for Governor instead of Jamie, humiliating him. Garrett and Christina push Jamie to run against his own father anyway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the family fight into an open political war heading into next season.

beats.label: S4 · Beth And Rip
beats.text: Beth is fired from Market Equities as the company prepares a major lawsuit against the ranch. She kidnaps a priest and marries Rip that same night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in Rip as family and leaves Market Equities as the ranch's open legal enemy.

beats.label: S4 · Kayce's Vision
beats.text: Kayce undergoes a four-day warrior initiation on the mountain. He returns with a vision that convinces him his marriage to Monica is ill-fated.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the crisis that defines Kayce and Monica's storyline going in.

beats.label: S4 · Beth Owns Jamie
beats.text: Beth gets Riggins to name Garrett as the man who hired the hit, with Jamie's knowledge. She forces Jamie to kill Garrett and dump the body, then blackmails him into obedience.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the state of play as season 5 opens: Jamie is Beth's puppet, and he knows it.

cliffhanger.text: John is running for Governor while Beth quietly owns Jamie, having forced him to murder his own father and buried the evidence. Jamie is caged, humiliated, and told nothing about what Beth has done for John.
questions: How long can Jamie stay leashed before he turns on Beth?
What does a Dutton governorship actually cost the family?
Can Kayce's marriage to Monica survive the vision he came back with?

characters.name: John Dutton
characters.line: Ranch patriarch, recovered from the assassination attempt and now the endorsed candidate for Governor of Montana.

characters.name: Beth Dutton
characters.line: Newly married to Rip, freshly fired from Market Equities, and holding blackmail evidence that makes Jamie hers.

characters.name: Jamie Dutton
characters.line: Broken adopted son who has just killed his biological father at Beth's gunpoint and remains under her control.

characters.name: Garrett Randall
characters.line: Jamie's biological father, exposed as the man who ordered the hits on the Duttons; killed by Jamie in the finale.
characters.note: Dead, but the reason Jamie is compromised going forward.

characters.name: Kayce Dutton
characters.line: Returned from a tribal warrior initiation with a vision that has shaken his belief in his marriage to Monica.

characters.name: Rip Wheeler
characters.line: Officially married to Beth and now raising a teenage boy, Carter, that Beth brought home from the hospital.

characters.name: Christina
characters.line: Jamie's ex-girlfriend, mother of his young son, and the political operative shaping his campaign against John.

characters.name: Summer Higgins
characters.line: Animal-rights activist John took an interest in; now serving a prison sentence after the airport protest arrests.

characters.name: Lynelle Perry
characters.line: Outgoing Governor running for U.S. Senate who endorsed John over Jamie, triggering the family's political rupture.
